_readme: Island quest sites. Loaded into the island_quests table every time the server starts.

Each quest is matched by quest_key: edit a quest here and redeploy to change it. Removing a quest from this file does NOT delete it; set "active": false instead so students' existing pins keep their quest.

unlock_myth: the myth_name of the myth portal whose quiz unlocks this quest (Pandora, Phaethon, Orpheus & Eurydice, Echo & Narcissus, Icarus & Daedalus, Eros & Psyche, Constellations). Leave it out to have the quest open from the start.
tier: core (required) or optional. pin_type: shrine, creature, landmark, poem, lair, guardian, monster.
min_words / min_lines: the editor shows a live count and blocks Submit until both are met (0 = no minimum).
points: alliance points awarded once, when the teacher approves the pin.
images: picture URLs shown with the directions, e.g. "/images/classical/myths/Pandora.png".
test_only: true = only students in the Test period see it. The quests below are SAMPLES until the real SIDE_QUEST_CATALOG and MONSTER_LAIR_GUARDIAN_QUEST content is added.

Heroic quest pieces: pin_type guardian (its visitor question is the Guardian's Test), lair (photo + four labeled dangers), monster (four attributes with counters + what the hero gains). A student's published guardian + lair + monster are faced together by visitors in an encounter.

quests.title: SAMPLE: A Shrine for Pandora's Jar
quests.directions: Build a shrine on your island where Pandora's jar is kept. Describe the shrine, who guards it, and what is still inside the jar. Use at least two details from the myth.

quests.title: SAMPLE: Orpheus's Song
quests.directions: Write the song Orpheus sang to Hades. Place it where it would echo on your island.

quests.title: SAMPLE: Draw a Creature of the Forest
quests.directions: Draw a creature that lives near Echo's pool. Photograph your drawing and add a short caption explaining how it connects to the myth.

quests.title: SAMPLE: The Guardian
quests.directions: Create the guardian who protects your monster's lair. Describe it, then write the Guardian's Test: a question every hero must answer to pass.

quests.title: SAMPLE: The Lair
quests.directions: Draw a map of your monster's lair. Photograph it, then label four dangers a hero must get past.

quests.title: SAMPLE: The Monster
quests.directions: Create a monster that seems impossible to escape. Describe it, give it four attributes that make it so dangerous, and decide how a hero could counter each one (a god's power, or knowing the myth). Then write what the hero gains by defeating it.
